model: free-draining discrete Gaussian Rouse chains; equilibrium activation; microscopic site absorption

sources.D0_m2_s: Frozen benchmark input: met.py at 52aa9addb, H package, T=700 K. Independently evaluated WLF using anchor T=473 K, D=kB*473/(10**-6.95*1e-3), C1=13.39, C2=45.28, reference=378.15 K. Benchmark convention, not a newly measured material property.
sources.Rg_squared_per_unit_m2: Frozen benchmark geometry: met.py at 52aa9addb, 0.434e-20 m^2/(g mol^-1)*104.15 g mol^-1/6. Benchmark convention, not independent experimental validation.
sources.sigma0_m: Frozen microscopic contact convention: met.py at 52aa9addb, SIGMA_CONTACT. Literal independent of target at execution.
sources.temperature_K: Dispatch benchmark temperature, 700 K; no data fitting.
sources.boltzmann_J_K: SI defining constant, BIPM SI Brochure, https://www.bipm.org/en/publications/si-brochure
sources.avogadro_mol_inverse: SI defining constant, BIPM SI Brochure, https://www.bipm.org/en/publications/si-brochure
sources.bond_rms_m: Each literal bond length enforces exact finite discrete-chain Rg: b^2=6*N*Rg^2/(N^2-1), from Rouse, JCP 21,1272 (1953), https://doi.org/10.1063/1.1699180. Finite-chain mapping varies b slightly with N; not an asymptotic prefactor claim.
sources.contact_shift: Gobet and Menozzi, https://arxiv.org/abs/0706.4042. Exact-OU use is qualified numerically, not covered by their Euler theorem.
sources.finite_box: Cubic periodic Laplace Green function regular part, independently recomputed by Ewald sums in run.py; not exact polymer finite-size theory.

allocation: Fixed rework allocation before any fresh candidate comparison. Exact OU mode transitions with state-dependent observation intervals; minimum contact step, maximum step and safety factor independently refined. Statistical/numerical uncertainties never fitted to candidate. Preliminary run stopped before candidate comparison: batches increased from 256 to 2048; counts increased to shrink sampling uncertainty. Engineering qualification ceilings revised to retain a total log cap of 0.55, strictly below log(2). The budget itself remains measured contrasts plus 4 SE, with no additive model allowance. Final precision extension, independent of candidate comparison: three independent stages at seeds offset by 100000; pool integer survivors. Final oracle is the largest box at the finest contact step; its own plateau is qualified. The largest-box correction is capped at 25 percent. Authoring and full verification both rerun every stage from scratch; there is no reuse option.
